name: Paul
note: The apostle who founded the church in Corinth, writing from Ephesus.

name: The believers in Corinth
note: A mixed church of mostly Gentiles, gifted and divided.

name: Sosthenes
note: Named with Paul as co-sender (1:1); perhaps the former synagogue leader of Acts 18:17.

name: Apollos
note: An eloquent Jew from Alexandria who taught in Corinth after Paul (Acts 18:24-28).

name: Cephas (Peter)
note: The apostle Simon Peter; some in Corinth said, "I follow Cephas."

name: Chloe's people
note: Members of Chloe's household who told Paul about the quarrels (1:11).

name: Stephanas
note: A Corinthian whose household were Paul's first converts in Achaia (16:15).

name: Crispus
note: A synagogue leader in Corinth who believed and was baptized by Paul (Acts 18:8).

name: Gaius
note: A Corinthian baptized by Paul; his house later hosted the church (Romans 16:23).

name: Timothy
note: Paul's younger co-worker, sent to Corinth to remind them of Paul's ways.

name: Jesus
note: The crucified and risen Lord, the foundation of the church.
